Privacy policy

About this portfolio

This website presents the professional work of Jamiu Abdulfatai.

Contact enquiries

The contact form prepares a message in your own email application. The site does not submit the form to a server. Your email provider processes any message you choose to send.

Local storage

Saved design resources are stored in your browser’s local storage. You can remove each item from the saved-resource drawer or clear your browser data.

Hosting and external links

The hosting provider may process technical request data necessary to serve the website. Links to external websites are governed by those websites’ privacy practices. No analytics or advertising scripts are included in this implementation.
